Topics · Hard times

How can I still do good for a parent who died?

The Quran gives a child words for a parent, and a prayer for forgetting and falling short. No more is claimed.

If you are in pain right now, you do not have to carry it alone. Please reach out to someone you trust, or to a local crisis line or emergency number. Find a helpline near you

Part 1 of 3

﴿وَقَضَىٰ رَبُّكَ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُ وَبِٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ إِحْسَـٰنًا ۚ إِمَّا يَبْلُغَنَّ عِندَكَ ٱلْكِبَرَ أَحَدُهُمَآ أَوْ كِلَاهُمَا فَلَا تَقُل لَّهُمَآ أُفٍّ وَلَا تَنْهَرْهُمَا وَقُل لَّهُمَا قَوْلًا كَرِيمًا٢٣ وَٱخْفِضْ لَهُمَا جَنَاحَ ٱلذُّلِّ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَةِ وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱرْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِى صَغِيرًا٢٤﴾

Translation of the meaning

And your Lord has decreed that you worship not except Him, and to parents, good treatment. Whether one or both of them reach old age [while] with you, say not to them [so much as], "uff,"[735] and do not repel them but speak to them a noble word. And lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy and say, "My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small."

Translator's notes

[735] An expression of disapproval or irritation.

Quran · Al-Isra 17:23-24

Translation

Listen to your father who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.

Original · Hebrew

שְׁמַ֣ע לְ֭אָבִיךָ זֶ֣ה יְלָדֶ֑ךָ וְאַל־תָּ֝ב֗וּז כִּֽי־זָקְנָ֥ה אִמֶּֽךָ׃

Proverbs · 23:22

World English Bible

The verse asks kindness to parents, then hands you the words: my Lord, have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small. A child can say it at any age and in any place, and it needs no parent in the room. So love finds another form after the farewell, one that still has somewhere to go.

A question for you

What are you carrying about the goodbye?

If you sayThat I was not there.
ThenThe third step says something about exactly this. Read it when you wish.
If you sayWords left unsaid.
ThenWhat was left unsaid can be said to God. The next step offers a prayer wide enough for it.
If you sayThat we did not part well.
ThenWhat lay between people does not cancel the asking. The verse sets no condition on what the relationship was like.

Part 2 of 3

﴿رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا﴾

Translation of the meaning

My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."

Quran · Nuh 71:28

Translation

This is the history of the generations of Noah: Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time. Noah walked with God.

Original · Hebrew

אֵ֚לֶּה תּוֹלְדֹ֣ת נֹ֔חַ נֹ֗חַ אִ֥ישׁ צַדִּ֛יק תָּמִ֥ים הָיָ֖ה בְּדֹֽרֹתָ֑יו אֶת־הָֽאֱלֹהִ֖ים הִֽתְהַלֶּךְ־נֹֽחַ׃

the Torah (Genesis) · 6:9

World English Bible

This is Noah's prayer as the Quran gives it, and in it: forgive me, and my parents, and whoever enters my house in faith, and the believing men and women. A child's prayer for a parent sits inside a wider prayer: the household, then the people. You need no perfect words, and you need not stand alone in it. You may begin with one short sentence, and it widens by itself.

A question for you

What is closest to what you need now?

If you sayA short sentence to say each day.
ThenThe sentence in the verse is short. Yours can be shorter.
If you sayTo talk to someone about them.
ThenSpeak of them. Remembering is a kind of faithfulness, and you need no permission to tell stories.
If you sayI do not know whether anything reaches them.
ThenThat is an honest question, and no knowledge beyond the verses is claimed here.

Part 3 of 3

﴿لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا ٱكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ ۖ وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Allāh does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. "Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people."[111]

Translator's notes

[111] Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) concludes this sūrah by directing His servants how to supplicate Him, just as He taught them in Sūrah al-Fātiḥah how to praise Him and ask for guidance.

Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:286

Translation

For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don’t have.

Original · Ancient Greek

εἰ γὰρ ἡ προθυμία πρόκειται, καθὸ ἐὰν ἔχῃ εὐπρόσδεκτος, οὐ καθὸ οὐκ ἔχει.

2 Corinthians · 8:12

World English Bible

The verse begins by saying God asks nothing of a soul beyond what it can do. Then it continues with a prayer: our Lord, do not hold us to account if we forget or err. The prayer itself was made for someone who forgot or fell short. You could not be present for a moment you did not know was the last. Whether more was in your power, you know best. The verse speaks of what a soul can do.

A question for you

How do you read your 'if only' now?

If you sayAs if it were a verdict on me.
ThenThe verse passes no verdict on you. It offers a prayer to someone in your position.
If you sayAs if it were love that found no place to go.
ThenIt has found one: the prayer. Do not hurry it, and do not press yourself.
If you sayI do not know. I only want to cry.
ThenCry. This page will be here when you come back.

The same in the other books

My son, help your father in his old age, and don’t grieve him as long as he lives. If he fails in understanding, have patience with him. Don’t dishonor him in your full strength.

Sirach · 3:12-13

World English Bible

“Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.

Yahweh, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times. Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, Yahweh.

ὁ δὲ ἔφη αὐτῷ· Ἀγαπήσεις κύριον τὸν θεόν σου ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ καρδίᾳ σου καὶ ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ ψυχῇ σου καὶ ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ διανοίᾳ σου· αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ μεγάλη καὶ πρώτη ἐντολή. Δευτέρα δὲ ὁμοία αὐτῇ· Ἀγαπήσεις τὸν πλησίον σου ὡς σεαυτόν. ἐν ταύταις ταῖς δυσὶν ἐντολαῖς ὅλος ὁ νόμος κρέμαται καὶ οἱ προφῆται.
